problem.name: Low Autocorrelation Binary Sequences
problem.description: Find binary sequences s in {+1,-1}^N that minimize the energy functional
problem.complexity: NP-hard, best classical heuristic scales as O(1.34^N)

autocorrelation_coefficient.note: Measures correlation of the sequence with a k-shifted copy of itself

energy.note: Sum of squared autocorrelation coefficients; lower is better

merit_factor.note: Reciprocal quality measure; higher is better. Undefined when E=0.

hamiltonian_mapping.description: The LABS objective maps to a spin-glass Hamiltonian with multi-body interactions. The interaction index sets arise from the Trotterized counterdiabatic unitary over 0-indexed qubit positions.

two_body_interactions.note: Each element is an index pair representing a 2-body ZZ interaction term

four_body_interactions.note: Each element is an index quadruple representing a 4-body ZZZZ interaction

topology_overlaps.description: Invariants counting identical index sets within and between interaction groups
topology_overlaps.I_22: self-overlap count within G2 (each distinct set counted once)
topology_overlaps.I_44: self-overlap count within G4 (each distinct set counted once)
topology_overlaps.I_24: cross-overlap: count of sets appearing in both G2 and G4 (matching by element equality)

counterdiabatic_schedule.description: Trigonometric annealing schedule for the counterdiabatic variational ansatz

annealing_function.note: T is total_time; lambda sweeps from 0 to 1

Gamma1.note: Numerator coefficient derived from first-order CD correction with h^x_i = 1

Gamma2.note: Denominator coefficient; depends on schedule parameter lambda

theta.note: dt is the discrete time step size

symmetries.description: Three involutory operations that preserve the LABS energy functional. They generate a symmetry group of order 8.
symmetries.canonical_form: The lexicographically smallest sequence among all images under the full symmetry group (compositions of all three operations and the identity)

incremental_energy_update.description: Efficient O(N) update for computing energy change when flipping a single position j. For each lag k, position j contributes to C_k through terms involving s[j]*s[j+k] (when j+k < N) and s[j-k]*s[j] (when j-k >= 0). Flipping s[j] negates each of these contributions, yielding delta_C_k = -2 times the sum of affected product terms.
incremental_energy_update.returns: tuple (delta_E, new_C) where delta_E = E_new - E_old and new_C is the updated autocorrelation vector
